name: MATLAS-138 (Hubble)
blurb: MATLAS-138, an ultra-diffuse galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: matlas138-hubble
story: A faint, ultra-diffuse galaxy far from the crowded hearts of galaxy clusters. Hubble took a snapshot of it to count the globular clusters around it.

claims.text: MATLAS-138 is a target of Hubble program 16711 on ultra-diffuse galaxies outside clusters
UDG stands for ultra-diffuse galaxy; the program studies their globular clusters
